title: The Midnight Alibi
briefing: The vault at Connaught Place was breached between 23:00 and 01:30. Suspects claim they were home before midnight. Extract all late-night timestamps matching 24-hour date-time format '2026-11-0[45] (?:23|00|01):\d{2}' to shatter their alibis. Beware of daytime and morning decoy timestamps.
evidence_text:
=== SURVEILLANCE & CELL TOWER TRANSCRIPTS [DELHI NCR] ===

[2026-11-04 23:42] CRITICAL: Unregistered vehicle spotted near Vault entrance: 2026-11-04 23:42.
[2026-11-05 00:15] CRITICAL: Vault perimeter alarm triggered at timestamp: 2026-11-05 00:15.
[2026-11-05 01:08] CRITICAL: Keycard swipe registered to suspect Alok Verma at: 2026-11-05 01:08.
[2026-11-05 08:45] Morning shift security turnover log: 2026-11-05 08:45.
[2026-11-05 12:00] Routine noon check: 2026-11-05 12:00 (Decoy).
